# AWS Developer Center
> Developer-focused hub for building, deploying, and learning on Amazon Web Services.

AWS Developer Center provides documentation, API references, SDK resources, code examples, tutorials, and community content for developers using AWS services and tools.

## Getting Started
- [AWS Developer Center](https://aws.amazon.com/developer/): Entry point for AWS developer tools, learning resources, and service guidance.
- [AWS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/): Central documentation portal for AWS services, features, and developer workflows.
- [AWS Getting Started](https://aws.amazon.com/getting-started/): Introductory guides and tutorials for beginning with AWS services.
- [AWS Free Tier](https://aws.amazon.com/free/): Overview of free usage options for experimenting with AWS services.
- [AWS Training and Certification](https://aws.amazon.com/training/): Official learning paths, courses, and certification information for AWS users.

## Documentation
- [AWS Documentation Home](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/): Main index for AWS technical documentation across products and services.
- [AWS Whitepapers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/): Architecture, security, and best-practice whitepapers for AWS workloads.
- [AWS Architecture Center](https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/): Reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance for AWS solutions.
- [AWS Well-Architected](https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/well-architected/): Best practices and frameworks for designing reliable, secure cloud systems.
- [AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/): Strategy and implementation guidance for migrations, modernization, and operations.

## API and CLI Reference
- [AWS API Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/index.html#api-reference): Entry point to service API references across AWS.
- [AWS CLI User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/): Documentation for installing, configuring, and using the AWS Command Line Interface.
- [AWS CLI Command Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/): Detailed command reference for AWS CLI operations and parameters.
- [AWS SDKs and Tools Reference Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/overview.html): Shared configuration and credential guidance for AWS SDKs and developer tools.
- [AWS General Reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/Welcome.html): Endpoints, quotas, regions, and general service reference information.

## SDKs and Developer Tools
- [AWS Tools and SDKs](https://aws.amazon.com/developer/tools/): Overview of AWS SDKs, IDE toolkits, CLIs, and developer utilities.
- [AWS SDK for JavaScript](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-javascript/): Developer guides and API references for JavaScript and TypeScript SDK usage.
- [AWS SDK for Python (Boto3)](https://boto3.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/index.html): Python SDK documentation for interacting with AWS services programmatically.
- [AWS SDK for Java](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-java/): Guides and references for building Java applications with AWS SDKs.
- [AWS SDK for .NET](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-net/): Documentation for using AWS services from .NET applications.
- [AWS Toolkit](https://aws.amazon.com/developer/tools/): IDE integrations and developer tooling for building and debugging AWS applications.

## Code and Examples
- [AWS Code Examples Repository](https://github.com/awsdocs/aws-doc-sdk-examples): Official AWS code examples for SDKs, services, and common workflows.
- [AWS Samples on GitHub](https://github.com/aws-samples): Community and official sample applications, patterns, and reference implementations.
- [AWS Workshops](https://workshops.aws/): Hands-on labs and workshop content for learning AWS services in practice.
- [Serverless Land Patterns](https://serverlessland.com/patterns): Serverless implementation patterns and example architectures on AWS.
- [AWS Builders Library](https://aws.amazon.com/builders-library/): Deep technical articles on distributed systems and operational practices at Amazon.

## Containers and Serverless
- [Amazon EKS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/): Documentation for running Kubernetes workloads on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service.
- [Amazon ECS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ecs/): Guides and references for container orchestration with Amazon ECS.
- [AWS Lambda Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/): Developer documentation for building and operating serverless functions.
- [AWS Fargate Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html): Guidance for running containers without managing servers.
- [Serverless Land](https://serverlessland.com/): Serverless learning resources, patterns, and tools for AWS developers.

## AI and Machine Learning
- [Amazon Bedrock Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/): Documentation for building generative AI applications with foundation models on AWS.
- [Amazon SageMaker Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/): Guides and references for machine learning development, training, and deployment.
- [AWS AI Services Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/): Documentation portal covering AWS artificial intelligence and machine learning services.
- [AWS Machine Learning Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/): Technical posts, announcements, and implementation guidance for AWS ML services.
- [Generative AI on AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/generative-ai/): Resources and service information for building generative AI solutions on AWS.

## DevOps and Infrastructure as Code
- [AWS CloudFormation Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cloudformation/): Documentation for modeling and provisioning AWS infrastructure as code.
- [AWS CDK Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/): Guides for defining cloud infrastructure using familiar programming languages.
- [AWS CodeBuild Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/): Reference and setup guidance for continuous integration builds on AWS.
- [AWS CodePipeline Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/): Documentation for automating release pipelines across AWS services.
- [AWS SAM Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/): Guides for building and deploying serverless applications with AWS SAM.

## Security and Identity
- [AWS IAM Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/iam/): Documentation for identity, access management, roles, and permissions.
- [AWS Security Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/security/): Security-focused documentation and service guidance across AWS.
- [AWS Secrets Manager Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/): Guidance for storing, rotating, and retrieving application secrets.
- [AWS KMS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/): Documentation for key management and encryption operations on AWS.
- [AWS Cognito Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/): Developer guides for authentication, authorization, and user identity management.

## Community and Learning
- [AWS Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/): Central hub for AWS technical blogs, announcements, and service updates.
- [AWS Compute Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/compute/): Technical articles about compute, serverless, and application architecture on AWS.
- [AWS Open Source Blog](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/): Updates and technical content about open source projects on AWS.
- [AWS re:Post](https://repost.aws/): Community question-and-answer platform for AWS technical issues and guidance.
- [AWS Events and Webinars](https://aws.amazon.com/events/): Upcoming AWS events, webinars, and developer-focused sessions.
- [AWS YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@amazonwebservices): Videos, demos, tutorials, and conference sessions from AWS.
